faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our premium porcelain tiles and architectural installation services.

q1.question: What is porcelain tile? How does it differ from standard ceramic tiles?
q1.answer: Porcelain tile is made from refined, pure clay and natural minerals fired at extremely high temperatures (1200°C). It is denser, harder, and virtually impervious to water (absorption rate < 0.5%), offering superior durability and color retention compared to standard ceramic tiles.

q2.question: What large-format porcelain tile sizes does Perla offer?
q2.answer: We specialize in imported, luxury large-format porcelain tile sizes including 60x120cm, 80x80cm, 100x100cm, and 120x120cm. These sizes are ideal for expansive flooring and feature walls in luxury residential and B2B projects.

q3.question: Where is the Perla and Hung Phat Ceramic showroom located? Can I visit?
q3.answer: Our showroom is located at K3.TT1.SH22, Starlake Urban Area, Xuan Tao Road, Xuan Dinh Ward, Hanoi. We welcome architects, developers, and homeowners by appointment. Please contact us via phone or Zalo to schedule a visit and view physical samples.

q4.question: Do you provide shipping and professional tile installation services?
q4.answer: Yes, we provide nationwide shipping and specialized, professional large-format tile installation services. Our experienced installation team ensures precise execution and high-aesthetic finishing for luxury properties.

origin.heading: Craft born from conviction.
origin.nameStory: In Italian, Perla means pearl — a name chosen for what fine porcelain should feel like in a room: depth beneath the surface, soft radiance, and quiet refinement. Like a pearl formed layer by layer, we believe exceptional interiors are built through patience, precision, and an eye for detail that never settles.
origin.body: Perla, established in 2020 and backed by Hung Phat, a company with over two decades of industry experience since 2004, was founded with a clear vision: to deliver premium ceramic and porcelain surfaces with exceptional craftsmanship, quality, and attention to detail.
origin.imageAlt: Archival photograph of the original Hung Phat workshop in Bat Trang, Hanoi

kiln.label: Origin
kiln.title: Born in Fire
kiln.body: Each tile begins as raw clay and mineral pigment, formed under 1,200°C. The kiln determines everything — density, tone, surface character.
kiln.imageAlt: Ceramic tiles being fired in a high-temperature industrial kiln

polishing.label: Refinement
polishing.title: Worked to Perfection
polishing.body: After firing, surfaces are calibrated, honed, and inspected by hand. Consistency across 10,000 m² is not automated — it is earned.
polishing.imageAlt: Artisan polishing and inspecting large-format ceramic surfaces

installation.label: Responsibility
installation.title: Installed With Intent
installation.body: We plan cutting waste to minimise environmental footprint. Good craftsmanship is inseparable from care for the spaces we build.
